M09.01.note: Known normal-sinus source example is distinct from learner practice. The source crop has no established lead label; lead-II wording is general teaching, not identification of this image. Electrical features do not establish effective output.

M09.02.note: Known sinus-bradycardia example uses approximate course-grid observations. Cause, symptoms, cardiac output and treatment cannot be inferred from its rate label.

M09.03.note: Known sinus-tachycardia crop has P/T overlap and unreliable PR onset. The approved narration does not treat 160 bpm as a universal diagnostic ceiling.

M09.04.note: Only the existing sinus-arrhythmia image is available. It has changing RR and sinus P-wave features, but breathing is not recorded and respiratory causation is not demonstrated. Respiratory mechanism remains a separate explanation.

M09.05.note: No verified sinus-pause, arrest, exit-block or post-pause escape illustration is available. Source three-second shorthand is not used as a diagnostic or safety cutoff. This entire lesson remains explanation only.

M09.06.note: Known examples support a qualified comparison, not a controlled rate-only experiment. No PAC or sinus-pause/escape example is supplied. Conditional checkpoint prompts remain learner controlled, unrecorded and unscored.
